title: Musicians on both sides: Frazier, Marrero and Barnes cousins
summary: He describes his father's guitar playing and the many musical cousins on his mother's side, the Fraziers and Marreros, and one cousin on his father's side.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
